pages.title: Base Glass
pages.text: Alloy four Nether Quartz for one Fused Quartz at 6,400 FE. An ordinary colorless Glass block alloys into one Clear Glass for 3,200 FE.

pages.title: Enlightened Glass
pages.text: Add four Glowstone Dust and one Fused Quartz in the Alloy Smelter to make Enlightened Fused Quartz for 3,200 FE. It emits light. Clear Glass has its own matching recipe.

pages.title: Dark Glass
pages.text: Add four Amethyst Shards to one Fused Quartz for Dark Fused Quartz at 3,200 FE. The dark variant blocks light. Clear Glass can also be made dark.

Use $(l:enderio:souls/soul_filters)Soul Tokens$(/l) to choose which entities collide with a glass block. Read the tooltip for the chosen rule. The recipe shown makes glass that is solid only to players. Inversion recipes switch a rule to its opposite.
Use dye recipes to match the glass to your build. Lighting, color and collision are separate properties. Try a sample in the intended enclosure before replacing every block.
